description: This file defines a React component 'MyBooks' that manages and displays a user's book collections. It includes state management for different book categories, fetches data from API endpoints, and renders either a list or shelf view with options to add books or shelves.

classes.name: MyBooks
classes.description: A React component to display and manage a user's book collection, supporting switching between list and shelf views.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Lifecycle method called after component mounts; fetches initial data and sets up resize tracking.

methods.name: getReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books marked as read from the backend API.

methods.name: getDidNotFinishBooks
methods.description: Fetches books that the user did not finish.

methods.name: toReadBooks
methods.description: Fetches books that the user intends to read.

methods.name: readingBooks
methods.description: Fetches books that the user is currently reading.

methods.name: onAddShelf
methods.description: Handles the event to open the shelf modal for adding a new shelf.

methods.name: trackCurrentDeviceSize
methods.description: Adds a resize event listener to toggle list view based on window width.

methods.name: onToggleListView
methods.description: Toggles between list and shelf views.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the component UI including toggle buttons, book display list or shelf view, and modals.
